about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P400 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport P400 is part of the current-generation L461 model, introduced in 2022 as the petrol mild-hybrid option in the lineup. It uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid assistance, part of JLR's Ingenium family. The AJ300P is a more modern design than the older supercharged V8s found in earlier Sport models, with fewer widely-documented failure patterns reported across the specialist community.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P engines for every Range Rover Sport P400 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol fitted to the Range Rover Sport P400 from 2022 to present (L461 generation). This is JLR's Ingenium petrol engine with mild-hybrid technology. No widely-documented specific known issue is confirmed for this variant — we still recommend a full inspection before any long journey. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300P rebuild.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P400 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The Range Rover Sport P400's AJ300P is a specific engine code within the Ingenium family, used exclusively on the current L461 generation. Because the AJ300P is a distinct unit from both the diesel Ingenium variants and the BMW-sourced V8s also fitted to the L461 Sport range, confirming your exact engine code matters for parts sourcing and rebuild specificity. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ300P) via registration or VIN
Whether your build falls in the early production period (2019-2020) for injector fault coverage

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
